tests.name: Separate temporary-project dependency-only installs for @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7 and @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8 with 180-second limits
tests.evidence: Both installs used distinct new empty projects outside any parent workspace and the exact command flags --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund. rc.7: TIMEOUT at 180.333 seconds, no stdout/stderr. rc.8: TIMEOUT at 180.340 seconds, no stdout/stderr. Only each task-owned process tree was terminated; both temporary projects were removed. Registry metadata and direct tarball access succeeded, lifecycle scripts were disabled, and the remaining boundary is dependency graph resolution or transitive acquisition; the exact substage is inconclusive from the bounded output.

tests.name: Conditional rc.8 npm timing/verbose retry
tests.evidence: Not run by contract: the extra retry is permitted only when rc.8 alone times out, but both rc.7 and rc.8 timed out.

blockers: Both clean dependency-only installs timed out after 180 seconds without output, so the exact dependency resolver or transitive network stage could not be identified and no rc.8-specific difference was established.
notes: Observed environment: Node v24.18.1, npm 11.16.0, Windows 10.0.22631 x64, PowerShell 7.6.4, registry https://registry.npmjs.org/, no proxy-related configuration present.

A preliminary pair of directories under the system temporary root was discarded after detecting an unrelated parent package.json; authoritative install evidence comes only from the reruns outside any parent workspace.

The evidence rules out failure to retrieve the top-level package metadata or tarball and excludes lifecycle scripts, but it cannot distinguish dependency graph computation from transitive package acquisition because both clean installs produced no bounded output before timeout.
The result does not establish dsh-vision runtime incompatibility: no DSH CLI, dsh plugin command, DSH_HOME/profile, credentialed service, or paid provider call was used.
No product source, tests, scripts, CI, package metadata, README, or docs/compatibility.md files were modified.
